summary: A set of summary notes covering the RFCs numbered 900 through 999, as a historical reference. It was replaced by RFC 1000, which covers RFCs 1 through 999.

eli5.summary: It is a short book report on a hundred earlier memos, so you can see what they were about without reading them all.

questions: what are the summary notes of rfcs 900 to 999
where is a summary of early rfcs
